title: BodyStructure in walk.rs declared pub but should be pub(crate)
description: walk.rs: struct BodyStructure and its fields are pub, but walk is a private module (mod walk; in lib.rs without pub). The type is not re-exported and never visible outside the crate. Declaring it pub instead of pub(crate) is misleading — a future contributor adding 'pub mod walk;' to lib.rs would accidentally expose BodyStructure as a public API type with no stability guarantee. Maintenance consequence: easy accidental public API surface increase.
